body.name: w_st
body.def: \(w_{st}\) is the average across donor folds of the intercept weight delivered by the selected order-\(r\) local-polynomial Gram inverse at \(\widetilde z_{\ell s}\), with the calendar fold containing \(t\) omitted when forming its score; set \(w_{st}=0\) as a bookkeeping value whenever that cross-fit inverse or training fold is undefined, and invoke the full-range interval branch.
